findings.description: Dense overlapping grass, perennial and silver shrub drifts restore the rain-garden identity while preserving clear paved walks and midpoint access links. Aerial and walking views are coherent and legible.
Independent reimport checked exact delivered hashes, finite contained bounds, 1044 full-width corridor rays, eight tree root openings, 126 midpoint link rays and all five native module ground datums.
Trees and repeating planting retain a stylized concept appearance; no drainage engineering or live-site performance certification is implied. 593772 triangles requires runtime performance check.
Original repository verifier samples beyond the exact north boundary due to positive ray jitter. Independent audit preserved width and moved terminal samples 1mm inward; no model geometry changed.

scope: Offline native level-fixture visual and geometry review only. Runtime terrain, bent routes, student editing, capture, new human approval and publication remain unreviewed.
